counterfactuals.best_case: paid pilot or strong-intent signal within the estimated window
counterfactuals.base_case: useful internal deliverable plus approval-ready outreach draft
counterfactuals.failure_case: buyer trust insufficient or pain not urgent
counterfactuals.fastest_path_to_cash: sell a scoped internal-only service deliverable before building a full product
counterfactuals.if_goal_is_cash_in_30_days: focus on service delivery and approved outreach, not product UI
counterfactuals.if_goal_is_paid_validation_in_14_days: use warm/targeted approval-gated outreach and offer one-pager
counterfactuals.if_owner_time_is_under_5_hours_per_week: Codex prepares all drafts; owner only approves and records responses
counterfactuals.if_customer_only_buys_done_for_you: position as done-for-you governed workflow/brief sprint
counterfactuals.if_grant_path_is_too_slow: defer grant path behind service wedge
counterfactuals.if_owner_english_friction_limits_direct_: build bilingual approval-ready scripts and use narrow written outreach
counterfactuals.if_codex_can_build_required_tools_in_par: build outreach draft generator, service workflow, and experiment tracker concurrently
assumptions: internal deliverable can be produced with current tools
counterfactuals.likely_outcome: internal validation now; external validation after approval
counterfactuals.risk: Buyer trust must be earned without case studies.
counterfactuals.cash_path_adjustment: reduce scope until buyer can say yes quickly
counterfactuals.minimum_next_action: owner review and approve or reject one experiment
